preconditions.description: The first argument must be a string.
The second argument must be an integer.
The position n must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: stdout == True if s[n] in 'aeiouAEIOU' else False
postconditions.description: The output is True if the character at position n is a vowel, otherwise False.

postconditions.expression: stdout == False if n >= len(s) else True
postconditions.description: The output is False if the position n is out of bounds.
